key.name: aod-mode
key.description: Dim the clock on black; restore the wallpaper on input and return after inactivity. Re-enable the extension after changing this option. In this mode, the brightness setting controls dimming and the clock always uses a black background.

key.name: aod-brightness
key.summary: Brightness while the clock is idle (percent)

key.name: aod-software-dimming
key.summary: Dim the image instead of the display brightness

key.name: aod-idle-delay
key.summary: Seconds of inactivity before returning to the dim clock

key.name: aod-fade-in
key.summary: Duration of entering the dim clock (milliseconds)

key.name: power
key.summary: Key to switch on power only

key.name: oled-shift
key.summary: Shift lock screen content (OLED burn-in protection)
key.description: While the screen stays on, glide the clock, date and notifications to a new random position every interval, like the Screen Shift feature of OLED TVs. The wallpaper is not moved.

key.name: oled-content-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the lock screen content (percent)
key.description: Shows the clock and notifications dimmer while the screen stays on, like the logo luminance adjustment of OLED TVs. 100 = unchanged.

key.name: oled-black-background
key.description: While the screen stays on, cover the wallpaper with black as long as the clock is shown, so only the clock and notifications are lit. The wallpaper comes back when the password prompt is shown.
